home.developer_intro: Aziz Chouchi, Full Stack Developer & Digital Innovator
home.passionate_description: Based in Tunisia, I design scalable, user-centered digital solutions. Specialized in Microservices, Cloud Native, Java/Spring Boot, and JavaScript (React, Angular, Node.js), I cover the full development lifecycle and apply DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD). With a background in multimedia and UI/UX, I deliver intuitive and impactful experiences, including projects in digital innovation and EdTech. Open to CDI, freelance, or remote opportunities in Tunisia, France, or internationally.
home.web_dev_description: Design and development of scalable web applications using Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, React, and Angular.
home.ux_ui_description: Creation of modern, intuitive, and user-centered interfaces to maximize engagement and usability.
home.database_description: Design of robust and scalable distributed systems to ensure high performance, maintainability, and flexibility.
home.devops_description: Implementation of cloud-native architectures, containerization with Docker, and CI/CD automation.
home.exp1_description: Designed and developed a social networking platform for event management. Implemented a scalable microservices architecture (Spring Boot & MERN) and automated deployments using DevOps pipelines (Docker, Jenkins).
home.exp1_skills: Skills: Microservices, Spring Boot, MERN Stack, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD
home.exp2_description: Development of custom web solutions including interactive educational platforms, UX/UI redesign of e-commerce applications, and business tools. Implementation of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation across multiple projects, with a strong focus on performance and software quality.
home.exp2_skills: Skills: Full Stack Development, UX/UI, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap, Angular, Symfony, Laravel, React, CI/CD, Docker, Jenkins
home.exp3_description: Development of a complete e-commerce platform using Symfony 5.4 in an Agile environment. Designed an MVC architecture and implemented core business features (product catalog, cart, order management, back-office, user management). Improved application performance and deployed the system using Docker and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for automated builds and deployments.
home.exp3_skills: Skills: Symfony, PHP, Doctrine ORM, Twig, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum
home.esprit: Private Higher School of Engineering and Technologies - ESPRIT
home.esprit_description: I am a Computer Engineering graduate from the Private Higher School of Engineering and Technology (ESPRIT), specializing in Web Development within the TWIN track. This program allowed me to strengthen my web development skills, deepen my understanding of programming languages, and gain solid experience in building dynamic and high-performance web applications.
home.leader: Leadership Experience: During my fourth year, I had the privilege of serving as a Delegate to the Scientific Council and the Discipline Council. In this role, I actively contributed to the academic and disciplinary aspects of the institution.This experience honed my leadership and interpersonal skills, fostering a deep sense of responsibility and commitment to maintaining a positive and productive academic environment.
home.isamm: Higher Institute of Multimedia Arts of Manouba (ISAMM)
home.isamm_description_3: At the Higher Institute of Multimedia Arts of Manouba (ISAMM), specializing in Multimedia Communication, I gained skills in design, development, 3D, as well as video and audio editing. My education has equipped me with a diverse set of skills, encompassing both creative design and technical development. This includes hands-on experience in 3D modeling and proficiency in video and audio editing, reflecting a comprehensive understanding of multimedia communication.
home.high_school: Pilot High School of Arts El Omrane
home.high_school_duration: I completed my Baccalaureate in Computer Science at Pilot High School of the Arts in El Omrane Tunis. During this period, I gained a solid foundation in computer science principles and practices.

footer.aboutMeText: Passionate about creating seamless user experiences, I'm Aziz Chouchi, a Full Stack developer based in Tunisia. With a knack for problem-solving and a commitment to delivering high-quality work, I thrive on tackling complex challenges and crafting awesome interfaces with a focus on UI/UX measures.
